_approach: A deliberate showcase of the top of the MPC swing scale -- 67% (engine 0.34), the point where swing tips into full shuffle and reads as more jazz/blues than house. Deliberately sparse: laid-back kick and clap velocities, hats placed only on the swung 'and'/'a' 16ths so the delay is unmistakable, one occasional ride accent. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
